Class Vehicle

java.lang.Object
com.example.software_meth_3_javafx.fleet.Vehicle
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<Vehicle>
Direct Known Subclasses:
Sedan, Truck, Utility
public abstract class Vehicle extends Object implements Comparable<Vehicle>
The class represents a vehicle with a license plate, obtained date, make, mileage, and pickup campus. Also has methods for comparison, equality checks, and string representation.
Author:
Carly Chick

    • compareTo

      public int compareTo(Vehicle other)
      Compares "this" vehicle to another vehicle (passed in parameter) based on location, Make, and then obtained date.
      Specified by:
      compareTo in interface Comparable<Vehicle>
      Parameters:
      other - the Vehicle to compare to
      Returns:
      0 if the location, Make, and obtained date are the same; -1 if this Vehicle's location comes before the other Vehicle's location alphabetically, or if this Vehicle's Make comes before the other Vehicle's Make alphabetically, or if the Makes are equal but this Vehicle's obtained date is earlier; 1 if this Vehicle's location comes after the other Vehicle's location alphabetically, or if this Vehicle's Make comes after the other Vehicle's Make alphabetically, or if the Makes are equal but this Vehicle's obtained date is later; Null pointer exception if the given Vehicle is null
